purpose: Research only; no PCB, case, manufacturing package, firmware, or quote changed

clearance_screen_limits: One candidate orientation, not an optimized multi-footprint design
Conservative pad bounding boxes; filled zones excluded
Provisional alternate contact pads 2.4 mm diameter with 0.2 mm copper clearance
NPTH clearances screened using drill radius plus 0.25 mm
This is not KiCad DRC, fabrication approval, or a physical fit validation
validation_needed: Measure selected switch sample pin locations and post diameters
Test seating and retention in exact acrylic plate thickness
Fit XVX cap and check full travel against raised case deck
Test a stabilized wide key as well as a 1u key
Compare actual acrylic-guide light output; an LED window alone does not establish improvement
installed_height_method: Derived from exact dimensioned drawing, subtracting below-PCB center-post projection from overall height; datum differs from advertised total height.
future_revision_implication: Alternate solder footprints can preserve matrix, controller and single-sided factory assembly in principle, but require copper rerouting and mechanical validation; no cost delta quoted.
